title: Logos 14 opening: further likeness — as the Father has life
english: Fourteenth discourse. Still on likeness, with “as the Father has life in himself” set forward.
Life-in-himself language is shared so the Son is not a lifeless instrument.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
